rows.grounds: genitive dependent indicating the object of agency
demonstrative pronoun referring to the subject under discussion
manner adverb indicating the resulting position

items.question: What agency is affirmed for transformation while denied for modification?
premises: This subject is the agent of transformation.
This subject is not the agent of modification.
The distinction between transformation and modification determines the attribution of agency.
items.inference: Therefore, agency is ascribed to transformation but withheld from modification.
uncertainties: The referent of ayam is not explicitly named within this verse and depends on the preceding context.
items.plain_english: This is the agent of transformation, but not of modification; therefore it is so.
